answers.text: Change page 36 from diagnostic to procedure; keep pages 37–50 labeled diagnostic.
answers.rationale: Page 36 continues the yearly maintenance checklist, while pages 37–39 contain troubleshooting material and pages 40–50 contain diagrams that support fault-finding.
